name: Outagamie County, WI
findings: Outagamie County has 667 nonprofit organizations. 335 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 270 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Outagamie County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 arts and cultural organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.text: 15 community organizations here list public events, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 35 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
